title: I was hopeful but ended up being disappointed.
text: I purchased the NIMO 15.6" FHD Student Laptop with 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD, and AMD Ryzen 5 3500U processor, expecting a solid budget laptop for the price. While the specs looked impressive, I was really disappointed with several key aspects of this laptop. The sound quality is extremely poor—tinny and barely audible, even at max volume. It’s a struggle to enjoy media or even hear video calls clearly without external speakers or headphones. The 15.6-inch FHD display is another letdown. The colors are washed out and muted, making everything look dull, and the screen lacks sharpness. I tried calibrating it, but the panel just isn’t up to par for anything beyond basic tasks. Battery life was also an issue. I expected decent runtime given the efficient processor, but it lasts only about 3.5 hours on fairly light use, which is far below what I’d hoped for in a this laptop. Also, the power button is unreliable—it often doesn’t respond properly, requiring multiple presses or even a hard reset to get the laptop to turn on. On the plus side, the 32GB RAM and 1TB SSD offers good performance for multitasking and storage, and the price was competitive for these specs. But the poor audio, subpar display, short battery life, and faulty power button make it hard to recommend.
